utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’m still in for the repair drive. What do you need me to help organize first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late—what’s the first thing that still needs a hand for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries—you can jump in with tool sorting first, since that’ll help everything else run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort tools and do pickups; what still needs covering for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — can you confirm whether we still need someone on drop-off coordination, or is the main gap tool intake and pickups?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Main gap is still tool intake and pickups; drop-off coordination looks covered unless someone backs out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive, Noah. Tell me what’s still needed, and I’ll check what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we still need duct tape, a couple of work gloves, and maybe extra screws—unless you already picked those up and I missed it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve already got screws covered, but duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves are still on my list. I’ll mark those as needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a little with the repair drive if someone shows me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but we should make a clear list first so nobody shows up without the right tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. If you want, I can sit down with you later and help make the list one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, how many volunteers do we actually have for the repair drive, and who’s bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet—I only heard second-hand that a few people signed up, and I think Raj and maybe Elena were bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s too vague—can you confirm the sign-up list today and ask Raj and Elena exactly what tools they’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard anything new about the repair drive yet? I’ve been asking around because folks keep wondering who still needs parts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard a couple folks still need hinges and outlet covers, but I’m waiting on a full list. I can bring my drill and spare screws once they’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That helps a bunch—I’ll pass along that you’ve got the drill and screws ready once the list comes together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, we should get the word out fast about the repair drive—I'll start inviting folks up and down the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good idea—I’ll note who’s already heard and cover the houses on Maple and the corner apartments so we don’t miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll hit Cedar and Pine and let everyone know the repair drive’s happening, then circle back so we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm which houses still need repairs and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still checking the list, but I know Maple 12 and Oak 7 still need repairs, and Dana and Luis have already signed up to help. I can confirm the rest once I’ve got the full sheet in front of me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m pulling together the repair drive details now, and I’d love your help lining up who can bring tools and who needs fixes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, send me the list and I’ll skim it for tools and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll send it over this afternoon with a simple sign-up sheet so we can match folks up quickly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks we’re doing a repair drive soon, Eli, so people can bring by stuff that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds useful, Vik. Let’s pick a day, a time, and a place so I can tell people clearly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s say Saturday at 10 by the community center, and I’ll start telling everyone that’s the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring those spare screws over, but I completely forgot. Do you still need them, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you still have them, yes, that would help. No rush, though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I do still have them — I’ll drop them by this afternoon if I don’t get distracted again. If I’m late, just holler over the fence and remind me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I’m in for the repair drive—want me to help pull a few people together from my side of the block?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Jules—if you can round up a few folks from your side, I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I’ll check with a few neighbors this afternoon and send you a quick update once I know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m rallying folks for the repair drive—can I count you in, and should I spread the word to the others too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, count me in—I might show up a little late, but I’ll be there. And sure, spread the word; the more hands, the better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let everyone know and tell them you’re joining a bit later—this repair drive’s shaping up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not much yet—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: First thing is the broken porch steps on Maple, then the fence by the garden lot. If we make a simple list and go one job at a time, it’ll go smoother.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I can help keep the list simple—who’s taking the porch steps first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Faye—thanks. Let’s slot you in between pickup and drop-off so it works for your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—that window works best for me. If you tell me the time, I’ll plan around the school run and be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m glad you asked about the repair drive—it’s shaping up nicely. I’ve been connecting a few folks who can bring tools and a couple more who just want to help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds great, Jules—I’ll mention around the block that the repair drive’s coming together and that we’ve got folks bringing tools and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that’ll really help. If anyone asks, tell them we could especially use folks who are handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox and a couple of spare clamps to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks—can you label your tools so nothing gets mixed up, and do we know where everyone’s setting up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll put my name on everything before I come. I haven’t heard the setup plan yet—want me to check with the organizers this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, do we know which houses on Maple are already on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got Maple mostly sorted—12, 18, and 27 are already on the repair drive list. If you want, I can double-check my notes and text you the full rundown this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got Maple 12, 18, and 27 noted. Please text me the full rundown this afternoon so I can keep the list accurate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, how many homes have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the latest count before I say a number—do you mean confirmed sign-ups only, or everyone who’s shown interest too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Confirmed sign-ups only—how many are locked in right now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—could you start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything we’re low on, especially screws, duct tape, and work gloves?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll sort the donated tools now and make a separate pile for anything we’re low on, especially screws, duct tape, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks collecting money or tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s both—money for parts and tools people can lend for the day. I might’ve missed a detail, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard second-hand too—maybe we should check with whoever’s organizing before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re really moving ahead with the repair drive, then? Just want to make sure someone’s actually confirmed the tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes—Marta confirmed the tools yesterday, and Ben says he’s got three volunteers lined up for Saturday. I’ve been checking in with folks all morning just to keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, if Marta’s confirmed the tools and Ben’s truly got those volunteers, then we might actually pull it off—have they both said it directly to you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—how’s the repair drive shaping up so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s moving along, slowly but honestly better than I expected. A few folks showed up, and that helps more than I can really say.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s really good to hear—sometimes a few steady hands make all the difference. Let me know if you end up short on anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, it slipped my mind for a second. Are we meeting by the community shed, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, by the community shed works. I’ll be there in ten.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—community shed in ten, thanks Leo. I’ll head over now so I don’t somehow forget again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help for an hour this weekend—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: First, can you confirm you’re definitely free this weekend? If so, the fence by the alley probably needs fixing before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’m free for an hour this weekend. Let’s start with the alley fence—send me a time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m fine helping, but we should pin down who’s bringing tools and where everything gets dropped off so nothing goes missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can make a simple shared list for tools and label a clear drop-off spot so it stays organized. I’ll also ask around and connect the folks bringing gear with whoever’s handling check-in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — I’d also feel better if we set a firm drop-off window, so people aren’t arriving at random and leaving things unattended.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now, so if you’ve got any items or volunteers to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll ask around this afternoon and send you any repair items or volunteer names I get.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — once you send them over, I’ll fold everything into the list and share the schedule with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s covering each job?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh gosh, I’m blanking on the full list, but I know the folding tables still need fixing and I said I’d handle those. I think we were still missing someone for the lamp rewiring, unless you already found a volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—tables are on you. So who can take the lamp rewiring, and what else is still unassigned?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do—I’ll keep you posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I appreciate it—just send me an update when you’ve got a better sense of numbers or what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a few tools by later, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d help a ton—folks keep asking if the repair drive still needs hands and tools. If you swing by later, I’ll make sure everyone knows you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright. I’ll stop by this afternoon with what I can carry.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks collecting money or tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: From what I’ve heard, they’re collecting both money and usable tools, but I’d like to confirm the list before saying more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ve only heard secondhand too, so I don’t want to mix anything up. If you confirm the list, let me know and I’ll pass it along carefully.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus — I’m in for the repair drive, just send me the quick version and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — quick version is we’re fixing small stuff for folks on Saturday in the church lot, and I could use you to bring a drill, extension cord, and any spare screws you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the drill, an extension cord, and a box of spare screws. What time should I show up Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we start the repair drive, can you confirm which houses still need fixes and what tools we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m joining late, but I think we still need to check the Morales and Chen houses, and I know we’ve already got hammers, ladders, and a couple of drills on hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—can you double-check whether the Patel house is already finished, and do we have enough nails and spare boards before we head out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive—want me to read it off?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please—read it off, and I’ll note where each item is supposed to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure—right now I’ve got nails, wood glue, spare hinges, two extension cords, and work gloves; I can tell you where each box is stacked as we go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I was thinking late morning, maybe around 10, but I can shift a bit if pickup makes that rough.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 could work if we keep it fairly tight, since I need to be free for school pickup later. Could we plan on starting right at 10?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, we’re pulling together a repair drive soon—want to come by and maybe help spread the word to a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive and I can spread the word around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s awesome, Sam—thank you! I’ll let a few more neighbors know today, and I’ll send you the details as soon as we lock in the time.
